task: write lru.py with a class LRUCache(capacity) that has get(key) returning the value or -1 and put(key, value), both O(1), evicting the least recently used key when full; and test_lru.py with pytest tests covering eviction order, updating an existing key, and capacity 1
checks:
from lru import LRUCache
c=LRUCache(2); c.put(1,1); c.put(2,2); assert c.get(1)==1; c.put(3,3); assert c.get(2)==-1; c.put(1,9); assert c.get(1)==9; c.put(4,4); assert c.get(3)==-1 and c.get(4)==4
d=LRUCache(1); d.put(1,1); d.put(2,2); assert d.get(1)==-1 and d.get(2)==2
